request: A receive folder is refused only when one of its path components is exactly .ssh in any letter case (.ssh, .SSH, .Ssh, with / or \ as separators). Any other folder whose name merely contains ssh, such as .ssh-backup, my.ssh or safe/ssh, is accepted and returned unchanged.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: add folding

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > src/croc/security_casefold_verify_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestNormalizeReceiveFolderAllowsSSHSubstrings|TestNormalizeReceiveFolderRejectsCaseFoldedSSHComponents)$' ./src/croc >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
